Zostel Spiti, Leo, Village Rd, Kaza, Kaza Khas, Himachal Pradesh 172114
Simple quarters in a casual hostel offering a cafe & a bright lounge, plus mountain & valley views.
Within the Spiti Valley, this relaxed hostel in the Himalayan Mountains is 3 minutes' walk from Kaza Bus Stand and 14 minutes' walk from the ornate Sakya Tangyud Monastery.

Simple mixed-gender dorms feature bunk beds, en suite bathrooms and complimentary linens, plus mountain and/or valley views. Private rooms and permanent tents are also available; some basic tents have shared facilities.
Parking is free. There's a cafe, plus a bright lounge with murals and a flat-screen TV. Bike storage is offered, as is breakfast for a fee. Electricity and running water may be limited.

Casual hotel with a cafe & a garden
Relaxed hotel offering mountain views, as well as a cafe, a garden & a meditation room.
On a tree-lined street, this laid-back hotel with views of the surrounding Himalayas mountains is off the NH505 national highway and 4 minutes' walk from Sakya Tangyud Monastery.
The simple, colourful rooms come with Wi-Fi access and en suite bathrooms. Upgraded rooms add TVs, tea and coffeemaking facilities, and/or mountain views.
Amenities include a cafe, a garden and a meditation room. Parking and bike storage are available, and there's also a generator.
